description: Remove prospect. Archive the prospect and end its mail. Its notes, files, and activity are kept; it can be added again later. Pass `?cascade=false` to keep its list memberships and open opportunities. Mail always ends. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_delete_prospects_id
